title: Apply to register a relationship in NSW
summary: Learn how to apply to register a relationship in NSW, which provides legal recognition for two adults in a relationship.
intro:
The NSW relationship register is legal recognition for two adults in a relationship, provided at least one of them lives in NSW.

If you and your partner would like to register your relationship, you can do so online.

Fees are attached to an application with the total amount varying depending on whether you'd like a relationship ceremony and/or commemorative certificates.

Note: Applications can be saved and resumed for a period of 14 days. If they have not been submitted within that time, they expire and you have to start your application again.
who_can_apply: At least one partner must live in NSW.
Both partners must be over 18 years of age.
Neither partner should be married to each other or anyone else.
Neither partner should be in a registered relationship in another state or territory in Australia.
Neither partner should be in a relationship with another person.
The partners must not be related by family.
what_you_need: Proof of identity (POI) documents (e.g., Australian passport, Australian driver licence, Australian birth certificate, ImmiCard).
Proof of address (required for the partner residing in NSW).
A current credit card for payment.
The completed 'Application to register a relationship – PDF' form, including statutory declarations, which must be witnessed.
Scanned copies of all completed documents, ready for upload.

how_to_steps.text: You will receive an email from Births, Deaths & Marriages (BDM) with your Online Reference Number (ORN).
Select the 'Instant LOGIN' link in your BDM email.
Complete the online form and upload the required documentation.
After you submit your application, your partner will receive an email from BDM with an ORN.
Decide if you'd like a relationship ceremony and/or commemorative certificates.
You'll both receive an email from BDM confirming receipt of your application and payment.
download and complete the Application to register a relationship – PDF, including the statutory declarations

more_info.text: You do not have to live together to be eligible to register your relationship.

There's a 28-day cooling off period from receipt of the application, after which the relationship will be registered. Within this period, you can withdraw your application, however your application fee won't be refunded.
Certificates are sent by the Registry of Births, Deaths & Marriages via registered post.

faqs.q: Who can apply to register a relationship in NSW?
faqs.a: Both partners must be over 18, not married to each other or anyone else, not in a registered relationship in another state or territory, not in a relationship with another person, not related by family, and at least one partner must live in NSW.

faqs.q: How long can I save an online application?
faqs.a: Applications can be saved and resumed for 14 days. If they are not submitted within this time, they expire, and you must start a new application.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply?
faqs.a: Each partner needs to provide proof of identity (POI) documents (such as an Australian passport or driver licence), and the partner residing in NSW may need to provide proof of address. A current credit card is needed for payment.
